May 14, 2018 - By Stephen Andrade
Investors sentiment decreased to 0.93 in Q4 2017. Its down 0.07, from 1 in 2017Q3. It turned negative, as 46 investors sold ACN shares while 393 reduced holdings. 108 funds opened positions while 300 raised stakes. 456.89 million shares or 1.00% less from 461.53 million shares in 2017Q3 were reported. Chevy Chase Tru Holdg Inc accumulated 737,563 shares or 0.49% of the stock. Mitsubishi Ufj Trust & Bk holds 1.27M shares or 0.34% of its portfolio. Independent Franchise Partners Llp decreased its stake in Accenture Plc Ireland (ACN) by 3.63% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Independent Franchise Partners Llp sold 228,471 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.27% with the market. The institutional investor held 6.06M shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $928.47 million, down from 6.29M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Independent Franchise Partners Llp who had been investing in Accenture Plc Ireland for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $101.02 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.34% or $0.54 $157.08. About 1.21 million shares traded. Accenture plc (NYSE:ACN) has risen 24.68% uptrending. It has outperformed by 13.13% the S&P500.
Independent Franchise Partners Llp, which manages about $13.30 billion and $11.79 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 51,744 shares to 3.71 million shares, valued at $627.02M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Oracle Corp (NYSE:ORCL) by 291,286 shares in the quarter, for a total of 17.65M shares, and has risen its stake in Merck & Co Inc (NYSE:MRK).
Analysts await Accenture plc (NYSE:ACN) to report earnings on June, 28. They expect $1.71 EPS, up 12.50 % or $0.19 from last year’s $1.52 per share. ACN’s profit will be $1.10B for 22.96 P/E if the $1.71 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.58 actual EPS reported by Accenture plc for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 8.23 % EPS growth.
